title: Shapley expectation
statement: For a function $f$ from the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$, its Shapley expectation is the expectation of $f$ under the Shapley subset probability mass function on those subsets.
hypotheses_covered: A function from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the Shapley subset probability mass function.
